metadata.title: The Context Window Isn't Memory
metadata.reformat: full-length; native portrait graphics; preserve source framing

short_validation.note: B04/B06/B11 authored as native portrait Manim scenes in vertical/scenes.py

beats.narration_text: Hi — Bella, in for Gomathy. Long chats seem to forget. It's a budget, not memory.

show.event: composer sits empty, spark line idle
the ask types itself into the composer
send arms; runningText 'measuring the token budget…'
output lines land, the ask lands answered

props.command: What is a context window, and what happens when it runs out?
output: A context window is a fixed token budget for one turn.
Everything in the request shares that one budget.

qc.sparse_reason: Two short lines of typed text on a mostly-cream page, mirroring the landscape BrutalistHesitantWriter beat (the house exemption named in final_frame_check.py's sparse_by_design_beats() docstring).

beats.narration_text: A context window is a fixed budget — not memory.

show.event: 'A context window is' / 'Claude's memory.' types in on two lines
'Claude's memory.' dims and backspaces out
'a fixed budget.' types in its place

shot.portrait_note: portrait Manim stand-in for landscape BrutalistHesitantWriter (one line can't reach GATE T's 72px portrait floor; two lines overrun the beat via the writer's fixed newline pause); same text and sequence, ink only

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 3 short single-word items doesn't reach 55% fill on a 3840x2160 canvas by design (same characteristic as B05/B07).

beats.narration_text: System prompt, tools, history — claimed before your new message.

layer 1 'system prompt' fills in
layer 2 'tool definitions' stacks on
layer 3 'conversation history' stacks on

items.label: System prompt
items.sub: Claimed first, before you type anything

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2 short single-word items doesn't reach 55% fill on a 3840x2160 canvas by design (same characteristic as B05/B07).

beats.narration_text: Your message counts too. So does Claude's reply — one shared pool.

show.event: layer 4 'your message' stacks in
layer 5 'Claude's reply' lands on top, accented
caption: one shared container

items.label: Your message
items.sub: The new turn you just sent

items.label: Claude's reply
items.sub: Generated, then added to the pile

beats.narration_text: The budget isn't words — it's tokens. 'Context' is one token. 'Windowing' splits into two.

show.event: title + running-total bar at zero, bottom third
'context' fades in on top, boxed, '1 token', bar grows to 1
'windowing' below splits into 'window' + 'ing', boxed, '2 tokens', bar grows to 3

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 3-4 short single-word items doesn't reach 55% fill on a 3840x2160 canvas by design (confirmed: fill % is identical at the 50% and 85% samples, so this is the fully-revealed state, not a mid-reveal timing artifact).

beats.narration_text: Code, numbers, jargon, and non-English text tend to cost more per word.

show.event: title 'Cost more per word' settles
four labeled boxes reveal in order: Code, Numbers, Jargon, Text in other languages

beats.narration_text: Add enough turns, and the total climbs toward the ceiling. Recall can slip past a point — that's context rot.

show.event: title + 'ILLUSTRATIVE — room remaining, not a measured trace' settle; tall bar with dashed fixed-ceiling line
turn chips stack up the left (Turn 1 → 8 → 15 → 22 — ceiling); ink fill climbs; readout 100 → 70 → 35 → 0
fill meets the ceiling at 0 left as narration lands on 'context rot'

shot.portrait_note: portrait Manim stand-in for landscape AttritionChain (no AttritionChain916); same data and labels, ink only

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 3-4 short single-word items doesn't reach 55% fill on a 3840x2160 canvas by design (same characteristic as B05).

beats.narration_text: Past that ceiling, what happens depends on the app — error, summary, or dropped turns.

show.event: title 'Depends on the app' settles
three labeled boxes reveal in order: Error, Summary, Dropped turns

items.label: Error
items.sub: The API can refuse the request

items.label: Dropped turns
items.sub: Chat apps can drop oldest turns

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 4 short items doesn't reach 55% fill on a 3840x2160 canvas by design (same characteristic as B02/B03/B05/B07). beats.narration_text: A bigger window isn't free. Filling more of it costs more — and doesn't buy focus.

show.event: title 'Bigger isn't automatically better' settles
four labeled boxes reveal in order: Small, Medium, Large, Very large

items.label: Large
items.sub: Costs add up fast to fill

items.label: Very large
items.sub: Still has to find what matters

beats.narration_text: Summary: a context window is a fixed, shared budget — not memory. Bigger isn't automatically better.
